system.description: You were raised among tutors, books, archives, laboratories, or institutions devoted to formal study and the preservation of knowledge.

legacy.name: Formal Education
legacy.text: Gain 1 additional Non-Combat Skill Point during Character Creation. This point cannot raise a Skill above the normal starting limit.

familiarity.name: Institutional Literacy
familiarity.text: You understand academic organization, citation, archival procedure, and the politics of formal scholarship. You can recognize obvious censorship, deliberate omissions, and records written primarily to satisfy institutional expectations. You also know how to identify the appropriate archive, specialist, department, or institution to approach when seeking information.
